env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME PTS, acme_pts. Each shop that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.
env.purpose: Your app's id in the App library, like acme_pts for the prefix ACME PTS

env.name: RGD_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix your app's names in the shop start with, in capitals: the --prefix you gave start.py (for example ACME PTS).
env.purpose: Filled in for you: the prefix your app's names start with, like ACME PTS

env.name: PP_MEMBERS_ONLY_ITEMS
env.purpose: Only for a run with no shop to read: the items only members may buy, separated by commas

env.name: PP_MEMBERS_ONLY_GROUPS
env.purpose: Only for a run with no shop to read: the item groups only members may buy, separated by commas

env.name: PP_MEMBER_GROUPS
env.purpose: Only for a run with no shop to read: the customer groups that count as members, separated by commas

env.name: PP_ASK_ABOVE
env.purpose: Only for a run with no shop to read: the sale total, in whole currency units, at or above which the till asks for ID; empty never asks
